metadata.name: ErmentroutKopellPopulation
metadata.author: Montbrió, E.; Pazó, D.; Roxin, A.
metadata.description: Exact two-state QIF-network firing-rate equations with explicit-Euler integration

dynamics.v: (v**2 + eta_bar + I + j * tau * r - (pi * tau * r)**2) / tau

extensions.source_equations: Montbrio, Pazo, and Roxin 2015 equations (12a-b); DOI 10.1103/PhysRevX.5.021028
extensions.source_change_of_variables: R=tau*r and t'=t/tau, so dR/dt'=tau^2*dr/dt and dv/dt'=tau*dv/dt
extensions.discretisation: Simultaneous explicit Euler; the publication defines the continuous equations and does not require this solver
extensions.time_scale_note: The maintained tau-expanded flow follows exactly from the recorded change of variables; it is not the form printed as equation (12)
extensions.identity_note: The public class name is legacy compatibility; these are not the Ermentrout-Kopell 1986 single-cell theta equations
extensions.output_note: r is a continuous population firing rate; no binary spike semantics are claimed
